title: Full Name Splitter Crashes on Single Names
description:
`split_full_name(full_name)` should return `(first_name, last_name)`. For a single-word name, `last_name` should be an empty string. For a name with more than two words (middle names), everything after the first word should be joined into `last_name`. Right now it crashes on single-word names and drops extra words from multi-word names. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`split_full_name(full_name: str) -> tuple[str, str]`

**Example**
`split_full_name("Ada Lovelace")` -> `("Ada", "Lovelace")`, `split_full_name("Madonna")` -> `("Madonna", "")`, `split_full_name("Mary Jane Watson")` -> `("Mary", "Jane Watson")`.
